verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar documents custom rules authored in the Dashboard using supported attributes, with block and review actions. Value lists can be referenced in rules, and trusted-customer lists auto-allow payments. A community report notes that Allow rules are off by default for newer businesses and must be enabled by contacting support. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that model risk scores and velocity counters can be used as rule inputs, documentation of combining multiple conditions in one rule, self-serve allow rules without a support request, and independent hands-on corroboration of rule authoring.
